business_goal: Let admins fully manage the item catalog end to end, with support for bulk operations in the future.
scope: Create, Read, Update, and Delete items in the catalog
Display items in a paginated list with sorting and filtering
Support server-side search and filtering for performance
Provide UI for item creation, editing, and deletion with confirmation
Ensure API endpoints are RESTful and return appropriate HTTP status codes
out_of_scope: User authentication or authorization beyond admin/manager roles
Advanced inventory management features like stock alerts or bulk updates
Integration with external systems or third-party APIs

functional_requirements.description: User can view a list of all items (name, price, quantity, category shown in the list) [EDITED-MARKER-771]
User can view a single item's full details
User can create a new item by filling out a form (name, description, price, quantity, category, image URL)
User can edit/update an existing item's details
User can delete an item, with a confirmation prompt before deletion
The item list should support basic search/filter by name
The item list should support sorting by name (A–Z / Z–A) and by price (low to high / high to low)
The item list should be paginated with 20 items per page, with navigation controls (previous/next, jump to page)
The item list supports server-side filtering and sorting for performance with up to 10,000 items
Search and filters (name, category, price range) are applied server-side with debounced live search on name

non_functional_requirements.description: The item list should load in under 2 seconds for up to 1,000 items
The UI must be accessible to screen readers (proper labels/ARIA attributes on the form and list, keyboard-navigable buttons for Edit/Delete/Add)
Support for up to 10,000 items total with server-side pagination and filtering
Search and filters should query the backend directly rather than client-side filtering

user_stories.goal: To ensure data integrity when editing or deleting items
user_stories.benefit: To prevent accidental loss or corruption of product data

user_stories.goal: To efficiently manage product information in the catalog
To browse the item catalog and view item details without logging in
user_stories.benefit: To view and explore available items without requiring authentication

user_stories.goal: To create, update, and delete item categories for organizing products
user_stories.benefit: To organize and maintain the structure of the product catalog

user_stories.goal: To efficiently create new items in the catalog
user_stories.benefit: To add new products to the item listing

user_stories.goal: To view and manage existing items in the catalog
user_stories.benefit: To maintain and update product information

acceptance_criteria.description: Creating an item with valid data returns a success response and the new item appears in the list immediately
Submitting the create/edit form with a missing name, non-positive price, or negative quantity shows a validation error and does not save
Deleting an item removes it from the list and requires confirmation first — canceling the confirmation leaves the item untouched
Editing an item and saving updates only that item's fields, without affecting any other item
Sorting by name or price correctly reorders the full list, not just the current page/view
Every API endpoint (POST/GET/PUT/DELETE /api/items) returns the correct HTTP status code for both success and invalid-input cases (200/201 vs. 400)
Pagination works with 20 items per page and supports previous/next and jump-to-page navigation
Search and filters (name, category, price range) are applied server-side with debounced live search on name

input_requirements: Image URL (string, optional, valid URL format)
output_requirements: List of items with name, price, quantity, and category
Full details of a single item
Success or error messages for CRUD operations
ui_expectations: A main page showing all items in a list/table/grid layout
An "Add Item" button that opens a form to create a new item
Editing opens the same form pre-filled with the item's current data
Deleting shows a confirm dialog before removing the item
Pagination controls at the bottom of the list (previous/next, jump to page)
Live search input with debouncing, plus filter dropdowns for category and price range

validation_rules.description: Price must be a positive number (minimum 0.01)
Quantity must be a non-negative integer (minimum 0)
Image URL must be a valid URL format if provided

constraints: Price must be a positive number (minimum 0.01)
Quantity must be a non-negative integer (minimum 0)
Image URL must be a valid URL format if provided

The UI layout will be responsive and follow standard Next.js conventions.
